Hello there ;)
Today, we've got something big for you - completely new mechanic for you to enjoy!
🎮 Gameplay
🔹Added scrap trading post
🔹Snow has been removed and the terrain has been restored to its default appearance
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505437/71db3cc4b238c40fc4868636fbc19cc8993eedc1.png"]
What is this new scrap trading post you might ask?

So to summarize, from now on, traders can arrive at your scrapyard with various items for sale. Each delivery is different, so make sure to check what they have brought before making a decision. You can also check the total value of the items on the display screen next to the scale.

Nothing comes for free, you will need to negotiate carefully and push for better deals to secure the best opportunities. Be mindful, though, that offering a price that is too low may irritate the trader and make them less willing to lower their expectations further. At the same time, your goal is to buy items as cheaply as possible and maximize your profit. The outcome depends entirely on how well you handle each negotiation, so balance assertiveness with strategy, read the situation, and make every deal work in your favor. After all, it is just good business!

👷‍♂️ 1.2.0 - Workers Update is live!
We've added employees to the Junkyard!
From now on, you can hire workers to help manage your scrapyard and automate some of the daily tasks. There are currently three types of employees available:
🔹 Container Workers
Collect and dispose of trash into containers.
🔹 Machine Workers
Place items into processing machines automatically.
🔹 Contract Workers
Deliver the required items to contract trucks.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505437/fd1923519bc939a031cc9daa39dc37670220c6e0.png"]

Employees can be hired through the Laptop, where you can browse available candidates and assign them to specific tasks. For example, you can choose which container a worker should manage, such as Paper, Plastic, or Metal.

Each employee has a star rating, which determines how fast they work. Higher-rated workers are more efficient, but they also expect a bigger paycheck at the end of the day. All employees receive their wages at the end of each workday.
If you'd like to increase the maximum number of employees you can hire or unlock more job offers, check out the Employee Upgrades section.

⚠️ Important: If you assign a worker to collect a certain item category (for example, Mixed), they may also pick up items that you have set aside for later. However, employees will never take items from the Garage or from the storage area behind the garage marked with black tape on the ground.
Hire the right team and keep your Junkyard running smoothly!
Have fun 🚚
Junkyard Team

items.text: 💠Possibility to manually save the game with the ‘Save Game’ button in the in-game menu↗️

💠Fixing the frequency of automatic saves and the correctness of saves when changing scenes in the game 🆗 - which used to happen in the case of long game sessions/large player progress in the junkyard 📶

Thanks to you guys for reporting bugs - you're amazing 💟 We are working further to eliminate more bugs. We keep reading the Steam and discord discussions. If you haven't reported a bug yet, please help us out!▶️
How to contact us with bugs?
Do it via discord 📢
Or via the Steam discussion📢
❗️ Remember - Junkyard is still in Early Access. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports ❗️
How can you support Junkyard Builder?
The easiest way is to share your opinion about our game with others on Steam or among your friends. Thank you very much 💗
Have fun 🚚
Junkyard Team
